question: In field hockey, in a penalty stroke, an attacker shoots at goal from _____ yards away in a one-on-one confrontation with the goalkeeper.
solution:
The correct answer is __**7 yards**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In field hockey, during a penalty stroke, an attacker shoots at the goal from a distance of **7 yards** away.
 
• This creates a one-on-one confrontation between the attacker and the goalkeeper.
 
• The penalty stroke is awarded for serious fouls committed by defenders within the shooting circle.
